what: The CodeMother device — the mother that watches over the codebase. Two faces: BUILDER (pattern library + 8 chart machines, proving what CC needs to know before a build begins) and WATCHER (graph-tree reasoning via inference_proxy + hex.local, monitoring the codebase between and during builds). Driven by inference_proxy, NOT by Claude — Claude is the builder; CodeMother has her own reasoning.
why: CC violated the ground loop boundary 3x in one day, 2026-08-29. Memory doesn't stick (corrected and repeated same day), flags are policy (comment in __init__.py), prebuild steps are task-specific (they answer what's asked, they don't manage ongoing context). Akien: 'I do not fear you papering over something, you've done it over and over. And I watch for it. CodeMother is a response to that. It is the mother that must watch over its codebase.' This device IS the physics (Law 4) that replaces the policy of 'remember not to do that.'
how: BUILDER FACE (built, proven): Two labs — intentions lab (compiled positive body) and constraints lab (compiled negative body). Five capabilities: (1) mine — cold-start pattern lattice from codebase scan; (2) training ingestion — parse transcripts, memory files, learning records, rulings, git history into negative types; (3) challenge — adversarial type-check of proposed changes; (4) query — what matters about X while working on Y, area-scoped; (5) digest — nighttime batch on Hex, consolidate corrections. Constraint proofs are three-sided: founding incident (measurement), live catch (ongoing proof), retirement (cause gone). WATCHER FACE (designed, not yet built): Reasoning path is graph trees first, then hex.local (qwen coding model) for nodes the trees can't resolve, then re-query graph trees — all inside inference_proxy. Triggers: commits (spreading activations), probes watching specific files, questions about an area triggering double-checking. NOT 'update everything to new standard' — targeted updates carried out as we go. CodeMother's trees have root questions part of her own root tree. Curriculum: CC failure modes (14+), the Cairn codebase, programming patterns, past project code, chat logs, computer books — absorbed via the reader + librarian. Role: prebuild packets with transparency and parsimony, model-level selection for tickets, pre-ticket question finding from intentions, spec the builder for cheaper tickets.
held_machines_why: The 8 pre-build chart stages — the preamble that grounds, bounds, sweeps, splits, ranks, predicts, and validates before a build begins. Migrated from builder device 2026-09-03 (ticket 484178f0cd8a). These are tools codemother uses to protect the codebase before code lands.
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) a pattern violation that would previously have reached code review is NOT caught at challenge time; (2) the device becomes a linter — deterministic checks belong in sieves, this is for learned/judgment-based patterns; (3) it becomes project-specific — portability to any codebase is load-bearing; (4) it fails to learn from corrections — a static constraint list is not what was designed; (5) the watcher face routes through Claude instead of inference_proxy — the whole point is independent reasoning. WRONG INTENT if: the device blocks CC from acting (it surfaces information as a peer, does not gate writes it doesn't own).

gates.proof_gate: tester runs proofs exercising the five capabilities against real code — a hollow proof that the device passes without catching a real violation is the specific Law 8 risk

owner: CC gates writes to the codemother device class; Akien gates the design.
how_it_learns: The device IS a learning system. BUILDER: mines codebases for positive types, ingests corrections/transcripts/memory for negative types, consolidates on Hex overnight, retires constraints whose causes are gone. Every CC-- and every Akien mistake feeds the constraints lab. WATCHER: graph-tree reasoning — spreading activations triggered by commits and file changes. Trees absorb curriculum (CC failure modes, codebase, past projects, chat logs, books) via the reader + librarian. The founding incident IS the measurement (Law 10); the live catch IS the ongoing proof; retirement IS the lifecycle.
traces_to: Law 4 — a rule that matters is enforced by physics, not policy. This device IS the physics.
I-the-system-is-a-learning-block — the system learns its gates from evidence.
CP1 — epistemic honesty: the device measures what it claims.
Telos — the system learns to constrain itself from its own operational history.
learns: Yes — this device IS a learning system. Builder: mines positive types, ingests negative types, consolidates, retires. Watcher: graph-tree spreading activations absorb curriculum and monitor the codebase.
